info.name: Dell Servers Dell iDRAC Redfish REST Accounts Alerts API

params.name: $top
params.description: Maximum number of alerts to return

params.name: $skip
params.description: Number of alerts to skip for pagination

params.name: $filter
params.description: OData filter expression for alert criteria

params.name: $orderby
params.description: Property name to sort results by

items.docs: Retrieves the collection of alerts generated by managed devices. Alerts include hardware faults, threshold violations, configuration changes, and audit events. Supports OData filtering and pagination.
Retrieves detailed information about a specific alert including the source device, severity, category, message, and recommended actions.
